purpose: Merge-only inventory and drop-cleaner progression that materially changes self-sufficient combat and Slayer routes. Acquisition currencies are stored; live item prices are not.

equipment_additions.name: Advanced gold accumulator
equipment_additions.effect: Automatically adds 90% of monster coin drops to the money pouch and destroys the remaining 10%.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Daemonheim is a hard Forinthry dependency in this project. Keep the 1,500,000-token purchase and optional 500-Slayer-point tool-belt unlock as separate milestones.

equipment_additions.name: Seedicide
equipment_additions.effect: Destroys selected seed drops and awards twice the Farming experience that planting the seed would give, provided the player has the Farming level to plant it.

pickup_upgrade.effect: Collects selected seeds instead of destroying them.

equipment_additions.league_treatment: Do not hard-assign Seedicide to one region: Asgarnia, Kandarin and Thaler routes are distinct alternatives.
